evidence.title: Pure Data Centres Group and SEGRO plc announce second joint venture to develop 48mw fully fitted data centre in Paris
evidence.attribution: Pure Data Centres Group and SEGRO plc
evidence.excerpt: Pure DC and SEGRO announce a proposed fully fitted data centre in a Paris Availability Zone, with construction conditional on planning and lease commitments and a reported 48 MW IT load.
